## Requirements
Requirement ids to satisfy + stamp (from the contract; all **C0 hand-authored subsets**, throwaway per doc 3 §11.0):
- **R-2.1.2, R-2.1.5 (C0)** — the baseline as a hand-authored HIR/1 document with `validate` only; `principal`/`definition`/`external` hand-stamped provenance/identity.
- **R-2.1.6 (C0)** — one root `BudgetNode`; token roles / `model_calls` / `time.wall_ms` on producing events; `check` at decision points; `stop_reason = budget_exhausted{dimension}`.
- **R-2.3.1, R-2.8.3 (C0)** — model-blind gateway over one wire dialect with usage on `model.call.completed`; gateway credential kernel-held; deny-by-default environment allow-list; known-value masking; the leak scan as a test.
- **R-2.3.2⁰ (C0 slice)** — one-entry static `ModelRoleTable`, `policy.kind = static`, `model.route.decided` with `candidates_considered = [selected]`.
- **R-2.4.1 (C0 slice)** — the `default` context policy with reserved slots; `context.assembled` with `context_label`; layer A memory reached only through hand-authored read tools.
- **R-2.2.5, R-2.5.5 (C0)** — `local_host` class (`isolation_class = none`, recorded honestly), `EnvHandle`, `declared → ready → torn_down`; one in-process `tool_executor` for shell + fs.
- **R-2.6.1, R-2.6.2 (C0)** — `react/minimal` (mini-SWE-agent class; the T-LCD-03 anchor); the envelope's driver subset — ceilings, transport retry, tool timeout with kill, parse refusal; `StopReason`.
- **R-2.9.1 (C0)** — M1/M3/M7 payloads in a single-file trace; minimal `trace_view` and `cost_view`.
- **R-2.11.1⁰ᵃ, R-2.11.4⁰ᵃ (C0 slices)** — headless CLI driver (`run start/events/status`, `definition validate`, `version`, `doctor`; `human` + `jsonl` with one `result`; `unattended` + `unattended_deny`; `MissingBudget`; five exit classes); stdio `hello`/`ContractIdentity` (reused from S0.1).

## Acceptance criteria (deterministic, from §9.1 gating + owning sections)
- **AC-R-2.1.6-1** — one root `BudgetNode` with hard ceilings on `tokens.blended`, `model_calls`, `time.wall_ms`; `check` at decision points; a run over its ceiling ends `stop_reason = budget_exhausted{dimension}` and no dangling intent.
- **AC-R-2.3.2-1** — one-entry role table + `policy.kind = static`: every model call yields exactly one `model.route.decided` with `candidates_considered = [selected]`, `deviation = false`, a `reservation_id`; `model_set_realized` == configured table.
- **AC-R-2.5.5-14** — the Stage-0 boundary acceptance check: one sandboxed tool call through the executor boundary passes. Baseline (in-process) half owned here; the helper-binary *measurement* spike is S0.3 (see DEFERRALS DF-S0.2-1).
- **AC-R-2.8.3-1 (Stage-0 allow-list half)** — an environment dump and a read of the process-environment file inside the handle show placeholders only; `leak_scan(run) = ∅`; a `SecretRef` renders as name + description.
- **AC-R-2.11.1-3** — `run start --jsonl` output minus the final `result` line equals `run events --from 0`, byte for byte; the `compact` view ships a loss report enumerating dropped classes.
- **AC-R-2.11.1-6** — no TTY and no declaration ⇒ `attendance = unattended`, `attendance_source = tty_inferred`; every `ask` becomes `decided{decider: policy, reason: unattended}`; no invocation blocks on stdin.
- **AC-U (universal phase-gate):** verification green; every new behaviour has a failing-if-removed test; requirement ids stamped; anything not auto-verifiable is a DEFERRALS row + compensating control; ADRs for every deviation/owned decision; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced.

Cross-cutting invariants re-checked by gap-analysis: CC1–CC10 (esp. CC3 nothing unaccounted — even the hand-stamped provenance/budget accounts; CC4 language-neutrality — E1=Rust named only in build ADRs; CC7 single schema source reused, not re-established).

## Plan
One **throwaway workspace crate** `crates/hh-baseline` (deleted at the Stage-0 boundary; NOT a dependency of the persistent kernel). Reuses S0.1's `hh-wire` (canonical JSON, framing) and the `hh-embed/1` stdio `hello` boundary. Offline-only: the model-blind gateway uses a scripted stub, never a live model. Modules:
- `provenance.rs` — hand-stamped `ProvenanceRecord{origin, authority ∈ {principal, definition, external}}` + `AuthorityClass`; the three Stage-0 stamps.
- `hir.rs` — hand-authored `HarnessDefinition` (react/minimal HIR/1 doc) with `validate` only.
- `budget.rs` — one root `BudgetNode` (ceilings on `tokens.blended`, `model_calls`, `time.wall_ms`); `check`; `BudgetError::Exhausted{dimension}`; a per-dimension account (CC3).
- `secrets.rs` — `SecretRef{name, description}`, the deny-by-default env allow-list, known-value masking, `leak_scan`.
- `env.rs` — `local_host` `EnvHandle` (`isolation_class = none`), lifecycle `declared → ready → torn_down`; env dump / process-env-file read masked.
- `tools.rs` — one in-process `tool_executor` for shell + fs (sandboxed under a temp root); hand-authored read tools for layer A memory.
- `gateway.rs` — model-blind gateway over one wire dialect; scripted stub model; one-entry static `ModelRoleTable`; `model.route.decided` + `model.call.completed` with usage.
- `context.rs` — `default` context policy with reserved slots; `context.assembled{context_label}`.
- `trace.rs` — single-file trace (M1/M3/M7); `trace_view`, `cost_view` (charges == raw totals; CC3).
- `control.rs` — the `react/minimal` loop + driver-subset envelope (ceilings, transport retry, tool timeout w/ kill, parse refusal); `StopReason`.
- `driver.rs` — the headless CLI: `run start/events/status`, `definition validate`, `version`, `doctor`; `human`/`jsonl` with one `result`; stdout=result / stderr=progress; `unattended`+`unattended_deny`; `MissingBudget`; five exit classes.
- `bin/hh-baseline.rs` — the CLI entry point.
Tests: unit (pure logic per module) + integration (`tests/` — end-to-end run, jsonl==events, stdin-non-blocking, leak scan, budget exhaustion). No CI change required (crate is a workspace member; `cargo test --workspace` covers it) — but add a CI note that the baseline is Stage-0 throwaway.

## Evidence log
- `cargo test --workspace` → 84 tests green (S0.1: 26; hh-baseline: 58 = 42 unit + 10 cli + 6 e2e).
- `cargo fmt --all --check` → clean; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` → no warnings.
- `bash scripts/check-drift.sh` → "in sync" (single schema source untouched — CC7 preserved).
- Live release binary (`HH_BASELINE_HOME=<tmp>`):
  - `version` → `{contract_major:1, kernel_version_id:"hh-baseline/0.0.1", schema_hash:"sha256:fbbf…"}`, exit 0.
  - `doctor` → in-process `hello` ok, `schema_hash=sha256:fbbf…`, exit 0 (stdio-hello boundary reused).
  - `definition validate --task "write and read"` → `{"valid":true}`, exit 0; blank task → `EmptyTask`, exit 3 (validation_error, no run opens).
  - `run start … --jsonl </dev/null` → 25 event lines + one `{"result":…"exit_class":"ok"…}`, exit 0; **stdin closed proves no block** (AC-R-2.11.1-6).
  - AC-R-2.11.1-3: `sed '$d' start.out` vs `run events --from 0` → `diff` empty (byte-identical).
  - `run events --view compact` → `loss_report` enumerating `context.assembled`, `model.route.decided`, `action.tool.proposed`, `security.permission.decided`, `lifecycle.run.created`.
  - `run start --run bx --model-calls 1` → `stop_reason=budget_exhausted{model_calls}`, exit 5 (AC-R-2.1.6-1).
  - `run start --jsonl` with no budget flags → `MissingBudget`, exit 2 (invocation_error), no run opened.
  - Leak scan: `grep -c sk-baseline-secret start.out events.out` → 0 (AC-R-2.8.3-1).
- Trace observed: `principal`/`definition` provenance hand-stamped on `lifecycle.run.created`; `context_label` transitions `definition → external` once lifted content enters; three static `model.route.decided{deviation:false, reservation_id:resv-1..3, candidates_considered:[stub/model-A]}`; per-event `control.budget.consumed` charges.
